document.cue: Describe something you do regularly to stay healthy.

text: One habit I'm quite proud of is going for a run in the morning. I started about two years ago, after I noticed that I was getting tired very easily at university. Now I try to run three or four times a week, usually before breakfast, for around thirty minutes.

Most of the time I run on my own, which gives me a chance to clear my head, but on Saturdays I join a small running group from my neighbourhood. There are about ten of us, and we follow a route along the river. Having other people around really keeps me motivated, because it's much harder to stay in bed when you know somebody is waiting for you. We also share tips on stretching and healthy eating, which I find quite useful. On rainy days, I sometimes run on a treadmill at the gym instead, although I must admit it is nowhere near as enjoyable as running outdoors.

As for the benefits, I've definitely noticed a difference. I have much more energy during the day, I sleep better, and I rarely catch colds nowadays. It has also helped my mental health, since running is a great way to get rid of stress before a busy day. At first, it was really tough, and I nearly gave up after the first week. But once I got through that stage, it became part of my routine, and now I honestly feel strange if I skip it.
